issues.display_title: Issue #195: Proxy batch panorama location updates to GoThru internal API
issues.main_description_html:
Follow-up to #188. FE counterpart: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap (Blue Line editor save).

The Blue Line editor needs to persist updated panorama coordinates back to GoThru (unblocking GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1111).
Upstream GoThru API provides an internal batch location update endpoint:
PUT https://api.gothru.co/v1/internal/panoramas/locations/batch

Because this requires the internal API key (Internal-API-Key), it cannot be called directly by the frontend and must be proxied through this API.

Upstream Endpoint Details

  • Method: PUT
  • URL: {GOTHRU_API_BASE}/v1/internal/panoramas/locations/batch
  • Headers:
    • Internal-API-Key: <INTERNAL_API_KEY>
    • Content-Type: application/json
  • Body:
{
  "tour_key": "string",
  "locations": [
    {
      "pano_id": 12345,
      "lat": -6.5745312,
      "lng": 107.795816
    }
  ]
}

Scope

  1. Config:
    • Add INTERNAL_API_KEY to .env.example and config loader.
  2. Authenticated Proxy Route:
    • Add route PUT /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas behind middleware.Auth().
    • Accept JSON body with tour_key and locations: []{ pano_id, lat, lng }.
  3. Ownership Validation:
    • Validate that the calling user owns the tour (check /v1/panoramas/locations?mid=:mid&limit=1). If not found/not owned, return 404.
  4. Proxying & Error Handling:
    • Forward PUT to {GOTHRU_API_BASE}/v1/internal/panoramas/locations/batch with Internal-API-Key header.
    • Return 200 OK on success with upstream response/data.
    • Handle upstream 4xx/5xx errors appropriately (502 when upstream is unreachable).
  5. Tests:
    • Unit tests with httptest stub (success case, unowned tour -> 404, invalid body -> 400).

Acceptance Criteria

  • INTERNAL_API_KEY read from environment.
  • PUT /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas proxies batch updates with internal header.
  • Ownership verified before calling upstream.
  • go test ./... green.

Result

Implemented and merged via PR #196:

  1. Config & Environment:
    • Helper internalAPIKey() in src/action/v1/gothru/token.go reads INTERNAL_API_KEY from the environment.
    • Documented in .env.example.
  2. Proxy Endpoint:
    • Added PUT /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas in src/routes/v1/gothru.go protected by middleware.Auth().
    • Handler UpdatePanoramas in src/action/v1/gothru/proxy.go validates :mid, non-empty tour_key, coordinates range (lat in [-90, 90], lng in [-180, 180]), and non-empty locations array.
    • Supports flexible deserialization for pano_id (accepts string or integer, marshaled as integer for upstream).
  3. Caller Ownership Verification:
    • Proves caller ownership of the tour via /v1/panoramas/locations?mid=:mid&limit=1 using the user's GoThru token before forwarding. Returns 404 if not found/not owned.
  4. Upstream Forwarding & Error Handling:
    • Proxies the batch update to {GOTHRU_API_BASE}/v1/internal/panoramas/locations/batch with header Internal-API-Key.
    • Maps missing configurations or upstream connection errors to 502.
    • Passes through upstream status and error details on failure.
  5. Testing & Verification:
    • Unit tests covering validation, ownership verification, string/int pano ID handling, upstream error extraction, and missing config:
      • TestUpdatePanoramasValidatesTourIDAndPayload
      • TestUpdatePanoramasChecksOwnership
      • TestUpdatePanoramasSuccessForwardsToInternalAPI
      • TestUpdatePanoramasHandlesStringPanoID
      • TestUpdatePanoramasReturns502WhenConfigMissing
      • TestUpdatePanoramasUpstreamError
    • go vet ./... clean.
    • go test -v ./src/action/v1/gothru 100% passed.
    • Verified end-to-end with the frontend Blue Line editor (GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1122, PR #1123).
